fields.label: Location (city)
fields.note: City aggregation of the refineSearch widget (native_param "city" inside selected_fields); state and country are separate aggregations.

fields.label: Country
fields.note: Full country aggregation (19 buckets); echoed back in ui_selections when applied.

fields.label: Category
fields.note: Category aggregation (12 buckets); short labels, not the indexed multi_category strings.

fields.label: Type
fields.note: Confirmed live: selected_fields {"type":["Part time"]} returned totalHits 1 (R172250, type "Part time"); ui_selections echoed type only.

fields.label: Remote
fields.note: Raw aggregation values; "Yes" means the posting is remote (15 of 271).

fields.label: Experience level
fields.note: experienceLevel aggregation; jobLevel (Individual Contributor/People Manager) is a second, separate aggregation not listed as a field.

notes: Phenom site. Entry redirects to https://careers.adobe.com/us/en (phApp refNum ADOBUS, widgetApiEndpoint https://careers.adobe.com/widgets); the search UI is https://careers.adobe.com/us/en/search-results. Filtering is a POST to https://careers.adobe.com/widgets with {"ddoKey":"refineSearch","selected_fields":{"country":[...],"city":[...],"category":[...],"type":[...],"remote":[...],"experienceLevel":[...]},"keywords":"...","from":0,"size":10,"jobs":true,"counts":true}. Unfiltered totalHits 271 on 2026-11-09, matching the 271 jobs in the eagerLoadRefineSearch payload; accepted filters are echoed in data.ui_selections. No sort control/values appear in the ddo or page HTML, so sorts is empty and the portal default (relevance/API order) is used. The adapter's own listing call sends keywords:"" with clearAll:true, i.e. it consumes this same endpoint.
evidence: POST /widgets selected_fields={"type":["Part time"]} -> status 200, totalHits 1, ui_selections {"type":["Part time"]}
